rationale: Price is at 99.2% of today's range, just $0.01 below the session high of $12.20, with only 48 minutes to close and a broad market under significant stress (SPY -1.47%, VIXY +9.69%). Entering long at the top of the range with minimal upside to the high and a hostile macro backdrop carries poor risk/reward, while shorting into a stock that has already rallied ~11% intraday with strong relative volume and momentum hugging the 9-EMA offers no clean technical entry either. The asymmetry is unfavorable in both directions at this price and time.
